patch_description: Introduce a repeat-specific global scaling parameter to modestly adjust the amplitude of all gates on the second repeat. This is implemented by adding a new per-block parameter delta_repeat and applying a (1 + delta_repeat) scaling to every gate angle when the repeat index is 1. To accommodate learning this extra parameter without exploding the search space, we append a single extra gate entry with param delta_repeat to ANSATZ_SPEC, keeping the total parameter count at 66 (11 params per block × 3 uploads × 2 repeats). This leverages parameter sharing while enabling a small hierarchical adjustment to the seed ansatz during optimization.
